name: Gem Fire Fortune

features.name: Multiplied free spins
features.description: Every bonus win carries a 5x, 10x or 100x multiplier.

review:
A gem cluster game where groups of five to 13 or more pay up to 35x in the base game, and any win can randomly get a 2x, 5x, 10x or 100x multiplier.

Three scatters give 10 free spins (three more add five), and in the bonus every single winning combination carries a 5x, 10x or 100x multiplier – a huge step up. Simple to follow with real upside. Up to 15,000x, 96.5% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
